system.creatureSubtype: Fortune on saves vs charm effects; immune to mind-affecting effects from non-Fae sources; does not age
system.sensesNotes: Darkvision 120 ft, Low-Light Vision, Truesight 60 ft, Tremorsense 120 ft (through roots and soil)
system.tactics: Forest Lords do not fight like soldiers. They reshape the battlefield, animate terrain, and compel those who oppose them to reconsider. A Friendly Forest Lord is a genuine force multiplier that will protect the summoner intelligently. Even a Cooperative one follows clear instructions well, though it will add editorial judgments about approach.
system.attacksNotes:
Branch Slam [Combat]: Melee attack (Agil 7 + Melee Combat 7), Reach: 15 ft

  • Margin 1:: 18 damage (12 + 6 Str)
  • Margin 2: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target is knocked Prone
  • Margin 3: 18 damage, DR halved (round up); target is knocked Prone and Restrained by animate roots until they succeed on an Athletics check (Hard task, 2 successes).
system.specialAbilitiesNotes: Forest Domain: In natural terrain, the Forest Lord can communicate with all plants and beasts within 1 mile. At will, it can cause roots and vines to animate in a 30-foot diameter, making the area Difficult Terrain for all creatures it has not blessed. Verdant Aura: Allies designated by the Forest Lord within 30 feet regain 4 HP at the start of their turns. Ancient Authority: Once per encounter as a [Combat] action, the Forest Lord addresses all creatures within 60 feet. Each creature that can hear it makes a Will save (opposed by Wis 7 + Empathy 5). Those that fail become Charmed for 1 minute, treating the Forest Lord as a trusted authority. Resilient Defense (3/day): When the Forest Lord fails a saving throw, it may choose to succeed instead. Action Points (3): Boss template. Spend at the end of any other creature's turn: Move (1, up to half speed), Attack (1, no Multiple Action Penalty), Detect (1), Special Ability (2). Regains all at the start of its own turn.
